4941.title: RPC handlers cannot observe caller departure
4941.rootCauseOneLine: The injected SDK times out its fetch, but the RPC route does not forward request cancellation and the handler context exposes only caller identity.
4941.proposedFix: Design a public cooperative cancellation context and propagate request lifetime; decide configurable timeout policy separately.
4941.caveats: No fix PR: public SDK contract and product-policy changes fail the simple-fix gate. No separate app/CLI UI run or historical-version rerun.
